title: Hero
description: An anonymous loser (Dustin Hoffman) sees another man (Andy Garcia) get credit for his rescue of a TV newswoman (Geena Davis) and others from a plane crash.

title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
description: An FBI agent (Colin Hanks) must spy on his mother (Meg Ryan) after she becomes involved with a suspected art thief (Antonio Banderas).

title: A Fine Mess
description: Two small-timers (Ted Danson, Howie Mandel) win a fixed horse race, buy an antique piano and run from gangsters.

title: Darkness Falls
description: The spirit of a woman who was lynched more than 150 years earlier haunts residents (Emma Caulfield, Lee Cormie) of a New England town.

title: Anacondas: The Hunt for the Blood Orchid
description: A scientific expedition sets out for Borneo to seek a flower called the Blood Orchid, which could grant longer life. Meanwhile, they run afoul of snakes and each other.

title: Red Water
description: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.

title: Lake Placid 2
description: Man-eating crocodiles return to the lake, as two males and one aggressive female crocodile protecting their nest, wreak havoc on the locals.

title: Lakeview Terrace
description: A police officer, the self-proclaimed watchdog of his neighborhood, becomes increasingly hostile toward the interracial couple next door.

title: The Art of War
description: Underground after being accused of murdering a Chinese ambassador, a security expert (Wesley Snipes) comes out of hiding when terrorists threaten the United Nations.

title: The Replacement Killers
description: An Asian crime czar pursues a forger (Mira Sorvino) and a hired gun (Chow Yun-Fat) who failed to kill a policeman's (Michael Rooker) boy.

title: U-Turn
description: A two-bit criminal (Sean Penn) meets an attractive woman (Jennifer Lopez) and her spouse (Nick Nolte), each of whom wants him to murder the other.

title: Mortal Thoughts
description: Best friends (Demi Moore, Glenne Headly) in New Jersey get in trouble after one's rotten husband (Bruce Willis) goes too far.

title: The Deep
description: New Yorkers (Jacqueline Bisset, Nick Nolte) go scuba diving in Bermuda and find morphine from World War II on top of a Spanish galleon.

title: The Fog
description: Residents (Tom Welling, Maggie Grace, Selma Blair) of a seaside community fall prey to malevolent entities hidden within the thick mist around their homes.

title: The Cave
description: Deadly monsters hunt members (Cole Hauser, Morris Chestnut, Eddie Cibrian) of an exploration team within a vast network of caverns beneath the Carpathian Mountains.

title: Total Recall
description: A factory worker (Colin Farrell) becomes a hunted man after a procedure goes awry that would convert his dreams of life as a spy into real memories.

title: The Stepfather
description: A young man (Penn Badgley) becomes increasingly suspicious that his mother's new lover (Dylan Walsh) is concealing an evil side.

title: Flatliners
description: Five medical students trigger near-death experiences to gain insight into the mystery of what lies beyond the confines of life. As their experiments become more perilous, each must face the paranormal consequences of journeying to the other side.

title: The Exorcism of Emily Rose
description: An agnostic lawyer defends a Roman Catholic priest accused of negligent homicide during the exorcism of a college student.

title: Godzilla
description: Nuclear testing in the South Pacific produces a giant mutated lizard that wreaks havoc upon New York City.

description: In 1980s Detroit, Rick Wershe Jr. agrees to become an undercover drug informant in exchange for keeping his father out of prison. When young Rick gets in too deep, he finds himself seduced by the lure of easy money and becomes a drug dealer himself.

description: A battle for the future of mankind unfolds when the archangel Michael (Paul Bettany) arrives at a roadside diner to protect a waitress whose unborn child is humanity's last hope.

title: Swept From the Sea
description: Locals disapprove of the love between an indentured servant (Rachel Weisz) and the shipwrecked Russian (Vincent Perez) she rescued in 19th-century England.

title: Swept Away

title: Miracle on the Mountain: The Kincaid Family Story
description: Injured when their private plane crashes into a snowy mountain, a domineering man (William Devane) and his family (Patty Duke, Elisabeth Rosen) face an avalanche and bitter winds.

title: No Mercy
description: A Chicago detective (Richard Gere) flees through a bayou, handcuffed to the Cajun mistress (Kim Basinger) of a ponytailed crime lord (Jeroen Krabbé).

title: Tortured
description: A mobster orders an undercover FBI agent (Cole Hauser) to torture an accountant (Laurence Fishburne).

title: Gloria
description: A street-toughened woman (Sharon Stone) goes on the run with a 7-year-old boy (Jean-Luke Figueroa) whose parents were killed by mobsters.

title: Desperate Measures
description: To save his terminally ill son, a San Francisco policeman (Andy Garcia) arranges for a sociopathic killer (Michael Keaton) to donate bone marrow.

title: Straw Dogs
description: A screenwriter (James Marsden) and his wife (Kate Bosworth) are pushed into a violent confrontation with locals after they move to the woman's Mississippi hometown for the summer.
